First post here, but I've been around /v/CustomizingVoat for a few days as I've worked out the CSS for one of my subverses, /v/Metro.

I was wondering if there was a CSS code to change the colors of the "tabs" of my subverse, especially when in the "light" mode. It would look way better if I could make them a very dark grey or a lightish black color instead of white, which doesn't go well with the overall dark theme.

By "tabs" I mean everything that the red arrows are pointing to: http://i.imgur.com/59Ypn7l.png
Is there a way to change the "tabs" on a subverse?

In addition to what's already been mentioned, you can target elements and make changes depending on light mode or dark mode. Just append .light or .dark to the beginning of the element you wish to target. So if you want to change the background color of the search box, but only change it for light mode you would specify: 

.light .form control {
 background: #444;
}
